themes.title: Funny Lost Dog Tag Sayings | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Funny lost-and-found dog tag sayings, from 'Call my mom' to 'Not lost. Taking a tour.' Your number goes on the back. Engraved from $12.
themes.h1: Lost and found dog tag sayings.
intro: Dogs wander. Bulldogs wander about forty feet and then lie down. Either way, the back of the tag does the serious work: your dog's name and your phone number, so a stranger has something to dial. The front is where we have fun.

These are our lost-and-found lines. Some are polite. Some are not. "Call my mom. She's freaking out" is for the honest owner. "Not lost. Taking a tour" is for the dog with a different story. "If found, bring snacks" sets expectations early.

Pick a line and load it into the builder. Change a word if you want. We won't be offended. The saying goes on the front, the name and number go on the back, and we send you a photo of the exact tag before it ships. Mis-engraved? We remake it free. Chewed it or lost it? The first replacement is $5 flat.
Scroll down. Find your dog's excuse.

themes.title: Funny Dog Tags With Attitude | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Sassy, smug and unbothered dog tag sayings: 'Certified menace', 'Zero chill. Full chaos.' and more. Laser engraved from $12, ships from Utah.
intro: Some dogs are sweet. Some dogs are sweet and also a menace. This page is for the second kind. These are the lines for the dog who steals the sandwich, hears cheese from three rooms away and ignores the 200 words you taught him.

Attitude tags work because they're true. Nobody has ever read "Barks first. Thinks never." and doubted it. Nobody has met a "Certified menace" and asked for proof. The tag just says out loud what the neighbors already know, and it saves you a lot of explaining at the park.

Pick one and it loads straight into the builder. Your dog's name and your phone number go on the back, engraved into the metal, not printed on it. Tags start at $12 and ship from Lehi, Utah. If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Choose your dog's attitude below, then give it a name.

themes.title: Funny Dog Tags for Family Dogs | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Dog tag sayings for the favorite, the baby and the dog with two moms: 'Mom's favorite. Dad's problem.' and more. Engraved from $12, ships from Utah.
intro: Every dog has a rank in the house. Nobody agrees on it. Mom says the baby. Dad says he doesn't have a favorite, loudly, while slipping him cheese. Grandma has already decided.

These are the tags that settle it. "Mom's favorite. Dad's problem." "Has 2 moms. Both worried." "Unpaid nanny. Call my mom." Some are for the dog who runs the house. Some are for the dog who was raised by cats and is still working through it. All of them put the family on the tag, where the whole neighborhood can read it.

Pick one to load it into the builder, then swap "mom" for "dad" or "grandma" if the house runs differently. The name and your number go on the back. Three or more tags in one order get 15% off. We have seven dogs, so we checked the math.
Find your dog's rank below.

themes.title: Beach Dog Tags: Salty, Sandy, Funny | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Beach dog tag sayings for salty, sandy, sun-dried dogs: 'Stay salty.' 'Surf dog. Zero skills.' and more. Laser engraved from $12, ships from Utah.
intro: Salty is in our name for a reason. A salty dog is a happy dog with sand in places sand shouldn't be. This page is for that dog.

There's the surf dog with zero skills. The one who can't swim but insists on the beach anyway. The sun-dried dog who is spoiled and not sorry. The dog who stole your sandwich and cited beach rules. And one chihuahua who has declared the sand lava and needs to be carried. Respect the lava.

The words are cut into the metal, not printed on top. Our own dogs have worn theirs through salt water, sand and whatever is in the yard. Pick a line, add the name and number on the back, and we'll ship it from Lehi, Utah. Tags start at $12. Sunscreen not included. Salt on the tag is fine. Salt on the couch is your problem.

themes.title: Funny Bulldog Dog Tag Sayings | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Bulldog dog tag sayings about snoring, drool, loaf shape and gas, written by a family with seven English bulldogs. Engraved from $12, ships from Utah.
intro: We have seven English bulldogs, so these aren't guesses. They're field notes. The snoring is real. The drool is real. The loaf shape is real, and so is the look they give you when the walk ends and they decide to lie down in the middle of the sidewalk.

This is the big list: wrinkles, underbite, stubborn streak and the occasional gas event. "Walk ended. I lay down. Negotiate." "Face like a fist. Heart like a pillow." "Built like a loaf." If you own one, you already know which line is yours. If you're shopping for someone who does, any of them will land.

Bulldogs have thick necks and wide collars, so check the size guide before you order: the bone, heart and paw run about 1.5 inches and the military runs about 2 inches. Name and number go on the back. Mis-engrave it and we'll remake it free. Chewed it? The first replacement is $5.

themes.title: Cute Dog Tag Sayings, Certified | Salty Dog Tags
themes.meta: Cute dog tag sayings with a bite: 'Small. Loud. Deeply loved.' 'Pocket-sized problem.' 'Smol. Loud. Yours.' Laser engraved from $12, ships from Utah.
intro: Cute is a lot of pressure. Your dog has to look at you with the head tilt, carry a tiny bow, and be deeply loved on demand. The least a tag can do is back your dog up.

These sayings are the sweet end of the list, with teeth. "I'm somebody's whole heart." "Soft. Sweet. Slightly unhinged." "Cinder block head. Marshmallow heart." "Head tilt is a manipulation tactic." Cute and a little bit dangerous, which is how we like them. Wearing a bow does not make a dog harmless.

Heart and round tags suit the small ones, and the heart says it before the words do. Pick a line, add the name and your number on the back, and we engrave it in Lehi, Utah. Tags start at $12. If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Your dog will accept the credit.
